method: Actual source audit and personal inspection of all eight fixed exact-GLB final views; no exhaustive triangle-intersection solver claim.
observation: All eight final frames personally opened. Hero/reversehero/front/rear show connected tapering axes, continuous narrow swept spiral leaf cover, open upper branches, and a low sprawling whole organism rather than a high crown. Side and top show real depth and branches rather than a billboard. Clay and silhouette retain the foliar outline. Seven artistic axes and646 leaf blades are a low-poly reduction, not a fossil-count claim. Small roots and branch connectivity are explicitly inferred/artistic. The compact artistic spread is smaller than nominal; actual measured bounds are separate. Leaves remain narrow and individual tips are small at512px; no claim that every attachment resolves in every frame. Stems/leaves meet with intentional noncoplanar intersections, not a Boolean botanical volume.
limitations: Closed source components do not certify watertight Boolean unions, printability, all intersections, or independent acceptance. Three traces use one closed integrated relief mesh.
